body_markdown:
OLATHE, Kan./Oct. 14, 2026/PR Newswire – Garmin (NYSE: GRMN) today announced the Garmin Marathon Series will expand to a fourth location in Ventura, California, on Sunday, Aug. 22, 2027. The event will feature a Boston Marathon-qualifying marathon, a USATF-certified half marathon, a 10K and a 5K, with courses showcasing one of California’s most picturesque coastal communities.


*“The Garmin Marathon Series has grown to include locations around the country and Ventura’s natural beauty, vibrant running culture and welcoming community make it an ideal addition as we expand to the West Coast. Whether you’re inspired by the ocean, the mountains or the miles in between, Ventura embodies the spirit of adventure and exploration that has always been central to the Garmin brand.”* *—* *Susan Lyman, Garmin Vice President of Consumer Sales and Marketing* **


Runners begin and end in downtown Ventura, taking in historic architecture and charming local businesses. They will also enjoy captivating views of the Santa Ynez Mountains and Pacific Ocean, framed by rolling hills and the trademark coastal beauty of the region. The routes are designed to highlight the juxtaposition of epic natural scenery and quaint, easygoing character of Ventura, delivering a memorable race experience for participants of all skill levels.


*“Ventura is proud to welcome runners, families, and spectators to our community for this exciting event. With our beautiful coastline, historic downtown, and strong spirit of community, Ventura is a natural setting for an event that brings people together through health, recreation, and shared experience. We look forward to showcasing our city and cheering on runners every step of the way.”*
*—Dr. Jeannette Sánchez-Palacios, Ventura Mayor*


A two-day expo will feature Garmin products, as well as activations from national brand partners and local vendors. Attendees can expect limited edition race gear from Garmin and family-friendly activities like a selfie station and sign-making area. After the race, a finish line festival in downtown Ventura will give runners and spectators a chance to celebrate with local food and entertainment. Both the expo and finish line festival are open to the public.


To ensure a seamless experience for participants, volunteers and residents, Ventura has formed a local organizing committee (LOC) that includes the following entities: Garmin, Visit Ventura, City of Ventura, Ventura Police Department, Ventura Fire Department, Downtown Ventura, Ventura Chamber and California State Parks, among others.


*“This event is such a great example of what Ventura does best: we come together. From our local partners and businesses to the many people helping bring the race to life, we hold so much hometown pride in our hearts. We’re excited to roll up our sleeves and welcome runners and their families, all while showcasing the kind of community collaboration that makes Ventura so special.”*
*—Marlyss Auster, Visit Ventura President and CEO*


The Garmin Marathon Series is a bold entry in road running events, wholly owned and produced by Garmin, a global leader in fitness technology and pioneer of the first running smartwatch. Registration for the Garmin Marathon Series is currently open for all race distances in Ventura (2027), as well as Tucson (November 2026) and Durham (May 2027). For additional information about the cities, races, community engagement opportunities and future locations, please visit[garmin.com/marathons](https://www.garmin.com/marathons) .


Engineered on the inside for life on the outside, Garmin products have revolutionized the aviation, automotive, fitness, marine and outdoor markets. Dedicated to helping people make the most of the time they spend pursuing their passions, Garmin believes every day is an opportunity to innovate and a chance to beat yesterday.
